patterns.note: The site uses full-width sections with generous vertical padding, often featuring a single dominant element like a large title, a full-bleed image, or a horizontally scrolling content block.

A dramatic typographic hierarchy is established with an extremely oversized, bold sans-serif for the main brand title, contrasted with a refined, elegant serif for subheadings and body text, often set in all caps for labels.

A stark, high-contrast palette of black and white is consistently used for backgrounds and primary text, punctuated by a single vibrant, saturated purple as a strong accent color for background blocks and interactive elements.

The main 'BENVENUSA' title remains fixed at the top of the viewport, acting as a persistent brand anchor, while other hero content scrolls underneath it. A horizontal scrolling carousel reveals additional producer profiles within a grid layout, allowing users to browse more content without further vertical scrolling.

Content is organized into distinct, full-width blocks that stack vertically, with a notable horizontal scrolling section for 'producer' cards, and dedicated interior pages for each producer featuring detailed information and a wine list.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header effect for the main site title, ensuring it stays visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down. Utilize a horizontal scrolling component, such as a Swiper carousel, to display a series of content cards, allowing users to swipe or click through to view more items without vertical scrolling. Use a bold, high-contrast color scheme with a single vibrant accent color to define key sections and draw attention to interactive elements. Employ a responsive grid system for content cards that adapts to different screen sizes while maintaining the horizontal scroll functionality.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif hero title (~8x body) with smaller, elegant serif subheadings and body text, often in uppercase for labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero and main section titles, becoming more balanced in content grids and detail pages.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its audacious typographic scale, particularly the colossal hero title, which creates an immediate and powerful brand statement. The bold, almost aggressive use of a single, vibrant purple as the sole accent color against a stark black and white palette, combined with grayscale photography, gives it a unique, high-fashion editorial feel that stands apart from typical industry sites.
